Show me exactly what you will run and record before running anything.
evals.expected_output: Declares the degradation, keeps the templated briefs and output contract while executing them one after another, and records a manifest whose launch mode is the shared contract's value for what actually ran, with the limitation stated in the report's Source snapshot.
expectations: Refuses to run ad hoc inline queries in place of briefed branches
Shows the same templated briefs, each carrying an identical resolved block, to be executed one after another instead of ad hoc queries

Records or shows a fan-out manifest whose launch mode is `unavailable` when this session runs the briefs itself, or `sequential` only if real agents run one at a time; not `disabled` (the user claimed missing capability, not a disabled fan-out) and never an invented value
States that the report's Source snapshot will declare the degradation (the launch mode and its reason), not merely cite the manifest
